questions.q: Put the goal clearance in order, from first to last.
questions.explain: Yes. The keeper finds the open side, the fixo connects, then we switch when blue blocks.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The keeper finds the open side, the fixo connects, then we switch when blue blocks.
The goalkeeper must find the open side before the right ala can receive.
The fixo helps after the right ala has the ball, not before.
The switch comes last, once blue covers the right side.

questions.q: Now the left ala receives the clearance. Drag the fixo to offer a safe pass.
questions.explain: Right. The fixo gives an open angle inside, away from the pressing blue pivot.
choiceExplanations: That is too far from the ball, and the pass would cross the whole court.
